description: ADO-RESYNC scope: client batch recordset of K IDs 1 to 4; for each (AffectEnum, ResyncValues) in (adAffectCurrent, underlying), (adAffectCurrent, all), (adAffectGroup, underlying) and (adAffectAll, all): connection B updates L of IDs 1 to 4 to a new value, 8 s, the recordset is positioned on row 2, Resync is called, and L of IDs 1 to 4 is read. Asks which rows each scope refreshes.
